claim.ja: 複素平面の非常に一般なr≥10点で、任意の重複度をもつ全非零有効曲線に厳密Nagata不等式。等重み多点定数は1/√r。
claim.en: For r≥10 very general complex plane points, the strict Nagata inequality for all nonzero effective curves and arbitrary multiplicities; equal-weight constant 1/√r.

role.ja: 普遍的な等重複度系を法束上に特殊化し、平方数は係数比較、非平方数は衝突とtheta行列の階数で排除。
role.en: Specialize universal equal-multiplicity systems to a normal bundle; use coefficients for squares and collision plus theta-matrix rank otherwise.

rows.displayName: Maximal Seshadri constants on arbitrary polarized surfaces

claim.ja: 固定した滑らかな整複素射影曲面とample Lに対し、十分大きい全rの非常に一般な点配置でε=√(L²/r)。非可算代数閉標数0にも拡張。
claim.en: For a fixed smooth integral complex projective surface and ample L, ε=√(L²/r) at very general tuples for every sufficiently large r; extended to uncountable algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields.

role.ja: 節点の指数境界・圧縮と有限トーラス群でjet単射性を作り、非等重複度曲線も含むnef性へ。
role.en: Node exponent bounds, compression and finite torus groups give injective jet tests and nefness against curves with unequal multiplicities.

rows.displayName: Maximal Multipoint Seshadri Constants in Higher Dimensions

claim.ja: 固定した滑らかな整複素射影多様体、n≥3、ample Lで、十分大きい全rの非常に一般な点においてε=(L^n/r)^(1/n)。
claim.en: For a fixed smooth integral complex projective variety of dimension n≥3 and ample L, ε=(L^n/r)^(1/n) at very general tuples for every sufficiently large r.

role.ja: 二切片変形を反復し、次数付き性による内部充填と全jetの全射性から下界を得る。
role.en: Iterate two-intercept reshaping, fill the interior by graded additivity, and obtain the lower bound from surjectivity onto full jets.

rows.displayName: Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in positive characteristic

claim.ja: 正標数の代数閉体上の固定した滑らかな整射影多様体（n≥2）とample Lに対し、十分大きい全rの幾何学的一般点においてε=(L^n/r)^(1/n)。可算体も含む。
claim.en: For a fixed smooth integral projective variety of dimension n≥2 with ample L over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, ε=(L^n/r)^(1/n) at the geometric generic tuple for all sufficiently large r, including countable fields.

role.ja: 形式的jet移送、標数2でも二枝のある節点、中国剰余定理で手法を正標数化。
role.en: Formal jet transfer, a node retaining two branches in characteristic two, and CRT adapt the method to positive characteristic.
